description: This file is a shell script used as a test suite for various Git checkout scenarios, including checking out branches, creating new branches, handling unmergeable changes, and testing failure cases.

methods.name: do_checkout
methods.description: Performs a git checkout operation with specified branch, oid, and options, and verifies the checkout succeeded or failed as expected.

methods.name: test_dirty_unmergeable
methods.description: Tests whether the current diff indicates unmergeable uncommitted changes.

methods.name: test_dirty_unmergeable_discards_changes
methods.description: Checks that discarding changes discards unmergeable uncommitted changes.

methods.name: setup_dirty_unmergeable
methods.description: Sets up a repository with unmergeable changes by modifying a file.

methods.name: test_dirty_mergeable
methods.description: Tests whether the current diff indicates mergeable uncommitted changes.

methods.name: test_dirty_mergeable_discards_changes
methods.description: Verifies that discarding changes discards mergeable uncommitted changes.

methods.name: setup_dirty_mergeable
methods.description: Prepares the repository with mergeable changes by modifying and adding a file.
